items.name: MyClaw 3.0
items.tagline: Build an always-on AI team with shared memory
items.description: MyClaw lets you build your own AI team with OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent, Pi, and more. Give each teammate its own role, tools, skills, and choice of 50+ models, with shared memory across your team. Your agents run on always-on cloud computers, use your apps, access data, and handle recurring tasks even when you're offline. Assign work from the web, Slack, Telegram, or WhatsApp. No server setup or lock-in to a single AI provider.

items.name: Airbot
items.tagline: The AI chief of staff that texts you first
items.description: Most AI assistants wait for you to ask. Airbot texts you first. It checks the conversations, meetings, and customer updates spread across email, Slack, your calendar, and CRM, then brings you only the priorities that matter. Behind every message is work already prepared: a drafted response, a meeting brief, a booking, or a CRM change. Approve what should happen directly in WhatsApp or iMessage. Airbot helps founders and lean teams stay on top of work without living in their notifications.

items.name: Snag by Parallel
items.tagline: Find the best deals on products from your agents
items.description: Find the best deals on the products you've been asking ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents about. Snag turns those conversations into a wishlist you import in one click, matches each item to the exact product, and checks prices across stores. Lists are sorted by best deal, every price is rated against its list price, and any list can be shared with a link. 100% free, in time for Black Friday. Powered by the Parallel Shopping API and Parallel Images API.

items.name: Canva MCP
items.tagline: Turn any AI agent into a creative powerhouse
items.description: Canva MCP opens Canva's creative tools to AI agents and developers. Generate editable designs, images and videos, remove backgrounds, resize assets and automate on-brand creative workflows with MCP, REST APIs and CLI.

items.name: Hiring Right Now
items.tagline: Which startups would hire you?
items.description: Paste your LinkedIn. Backdoor reads your work, searches growing startups and shows you the ones that fit, the founder to write to, and the email to send them. Free, no signup required, takes about two minutes.

items.name: Fompi
items.tagline: Personal security & privacy companion that calls out risks
items.description: Fompi sits quietly in your browser and on your Mac, and speaks up when it matters: a scam page, a phishing email, a disguised download, an AI notetaker in your call, an app on your mic, a card number headed for an AI chat. It tells you why. Free to start :)

items.name: Koed
items.tagline: Supercharged Agents!
items.description: Koed gives each coding project its own Kin: a customisable assistant that remembers how you like to work, the decisions you’ve made and what you’ve already tried. Your Kin reasons over that context to give Claude Code, Codex and Pi guidance shaped by your project, helping your agents work faster and use fewer tokens. Koed runs on-device and is free and open source. It’s available now for solo developers, with more coding agent integrations, optional cloud processing and team sharing coming soon.

items.name: Hai
items.tagline: Your AI assistant that actually makes the phone call
items.description: Some bookings still only happen by phone, and plenty of us dread making that call. For people who are deaf, hard of hearing, or have speech or anxiety barriers, that call can be impossible. Hai makes it for you. Tell your assistant what you need, approve the plan, and Hai places the call in any language to any business that takes bookings by phone, then reports back in text. Free to start. Built by an indie developer in Japan.

items.name: Omi X 2.0
items.tagline: Omi can build anything. Your $1B idea, live in production
items.description: Omi can build anything. Omi X 2.0 is the desktop app for Mac and Windows that builds a production AI SaaS on your own Google Cloud and Firebase. New in 2.0: Point and edit lets you click any part of your running app and tell Omi what to change. Open an existing project brings in your own Next.js app; Omi tests, builds and deploys it. New projects start from a tested starter. Plan free, no card; building from $29 a month.

items.name: 3way.Social MCP
items.tagline: Ask your AI to find link partners. You approve the deals.
items.description: 3way.Social is a fair, credit-based marketplace for link insertions and guest posts, with no cold outreach. Each site chooses what it buys and sells, links are priced on industry-standard metrics (DR, traffic, spam score), and if a link disappears you get your credits back. AI discovery finds specific pages on your topic, not just domains. The MCP brings it into Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT: ask for partner pages for your new post, then approve the deal.

items.name: RelayRunner
items.tagline: Swap between CI runners on-demand with zero code changes.
items.description: RelayRunner is a router for your existing CI runners, so you can use multiple providers or self-hosted options at the same time. Send each GitHub Actions job to the first free runner in your order: your own Mac, self-hosted runners, GitHub's default runners, or providers like Blacksmith and Boat. Change the order any time without touching your workflows. Open source, with a Mac app and a CLI that turn any machine into a runner on-demand.

items.name: eluna
items.tagline: Period tracker for couples that explains WHY, not just WHEN
items.description: most period trackers are a calendar with a countdown. eluna tells you WHY. a one minute check in and it writes a line from her own data: why day 24 feels heavy, why the bloating is back, what's coming next. ask eluna anything and it answers from her history, not a leaflet. then the part made for couples: partner mode gives him a heads up before the harder days, not after the fight. iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch, 7 languages, free to start, built by a husband and wife

items.name: Falcon by Vybe
items.tagline: Falcon analyzes your competitors for free, then gets to work
items.description: Get a free competitor analysis. Falcon, a Vybe agent, digs into your rivals and delivers a deep report: market landscape, feature parity, momentum, gaps left open, and competitors' go-to-market motions. The whole picture, not just a list of competitors. Want more than the report? Falcon runs on Vybe, so you can let an agent take the wheel, keep you updated on where the market is headed and turn the findings into work.

items.name: MAGI-2
items.tagline: Sand AI's 480B model for cinematic video generation
items.description: MAGI-2 is Sand AI's flagship video generation model, creating up to 30 seconds of 1080p video with synchronized native audio. Combine up to 20 image, video, and audio references to guide characters, scenes, styles, and sound. Direct shot changes and timeline events, or edit specific parts of existing videos. Built for creators who want more control over cinematic AI video production. Available through the Sand AI platform and API.

items.name: Tray
items.tagline: macOS file manager in a screen corner
items.description: A file manager for macOS that lives in a screen corner. Drop files on the shelf, preview them, group them into a folder, drag them anywhere, or send them to the Bin — without opening Finder.

items.name: VibeCode.surf
items.tagline: AI code editor where agents build, run and test your app
items.description: VibeCode.surf is an AI code editor for your desktop. Several agents plan, write, run and test your code on your own computer, with any model. Say what you want, and a lead agent splits the job across helpers that write the code, run it and test it in a real browser. It runs on your computer with any model, from Claude and GPT to a local one, and shows what every reply costs.

items.name: Tendeck
items.tagline: Run all your Claude Code and Codex agents on one Mac board
items.description: Every coding agent becomes a card on one board. The card turns gold when an agent needs you, so nothing waits 40 minutes for a "yes". Claude Code, Codex or any agent CLI, with worktrees, account switching and files on the card. $59 once.

items.name: MemoryWorks
items.tagline: Company memory for people and AI agents
items.description: MemoryWorks is the memory layer for engineering organizations. It captures decisions, context and know-how from your team's sources and makes it available to people and AI agents, always tied back to where it came from. Works with ChatGPT and Claude Code via an MCP server. Open source (AGPL-3.0).

items.name: Blink
items.tagline: Describe any trade and watch Blink build it
items.description: "If they announce Jensen is back, long NVDA and short AMD." The news that moves a stock usually lands while you're asleep or in a meeting, and by the time you see it the move is over. Blink is a trading app where you describe any trade in plain English and it builds it, then watches around the clock. It can trigger on a post on X, a headline, an earnings result, a line said on a live earnings call or a shift in prediction market odds, and it places the trade the moment it happens.

items.name: SteerLatch
items.tagline: Connect MCP-compatible AIs to your computer
items.description: SteerLatch connects MCP-compatible AIs to your authorized Mac/Windows PC: files, desktop, terminal, STOP and revocable access. NEW: control your paired PC from a phone/browser after local setup, while AI works. SteerLatch Context Hub shares project memory and messages across agents. Official apps are live on Apple App Store (iPhone companion) and Microsoft Store (Windows). Free 3-month trial: 3 PCs, 5,000 MCP calls/month, no card.
